source: us-atlas (Census Bureau TIGER/Line, via npm registry.npmjs.org) for MD/DE/NJ/NY; highcharts/map-collection-dist ca-qc-all.topo.json (real MRC/TE boundaries) for the Québec corridor, decoded via topojson and pulled via npm registry since statcan.gc.ca was not reachable from this network

qc.name: Québec (southern MRC corridor)
qc.note: cropped to MRCs with maxlat<=47.9, lon between -78.0 and -69.5, so the drawn area stays proportionate to the MD/DE/NJ/NY combined bounding box; the outer outline is a shapely unary_union of these real MRC polygons rather than 66 overlapping individual outlines

note: Highway routes are real city waypoint coordinates connected with straight/dashed lines, not an actual road-centerline shapefile (TIGER/Line road data and OSM/Overpass were unreachable from this network).
